title: Non-blocking follow-ups from PR #107 review (frontend-chart-signal-overlay)
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #107 (frontend-chart-signal-overlay), recorded here so they aren't lost once that PR merges. None of these blocked the PR on their own (the blocking finding — the effect-cleanup-ordering crash — is tracked as a needs_work verdict on the parent task itself, not here).

checklist.step: PriceChart.tsx's overlay effect iterates `points` three separate times (once each for the EMA13 series data, the EMA26 series data, and inside buildSignalMarkers) instead of building all three outputs in a single pass. Harmless at current data sizes but wasted work that scales with the requested range (up to 'max').

The four-clause overlay-state guard (`historyQuery.isSuccess && hasBars && overlayEnabled && ...`) is duplicated verbatim across three separate JSX blocks (loading/error/empty) in PriceChart.tsx instead of being computed once into a single boolean and reused — a maintenance hazard if the gating condition ever needs to change.

frontend/tests/e2e/stock-analysis.spec.ts's 'range and interval toggles reload the price chart without erroring' test exercises the exact range/interval-toggle path where the parent task's blocking crash was found, but doesn't wait for the /indicators overlay to actually mount before interacting, so it doesn't reliably catch overlay-related regressions on that path. Once the parent task's crash fix lands, strengthen this spec (or add a new one) to explicitly wait for the overlay to render before toggling range/interval, and assert the chart (and ideally the overlay) survives the interaction rather than only checking price-chart-canvas visibility.

decisions.decision: All three non-blocking follow-ups were addressed directly on PR #107 (branch task/frontend-chart-signal-overlay) while fixing the parent task's blocking crash, rather than left for a separate follow-up PR.
decisions.rationale: The crash fix already touched the overlay effect and its surrounding JSX in frontend/src/features/stocks/components/PriceChart.tsx, and the e2e spec strengthening was explicitly required to actually verify the crash fix (a repro that doesn't wait for the overlay to mount wouldn't reliably exercise the race at all) — doing all three in the same change was strictly less total work than reopening the same functions in a second PR, with no conflicting judgment calls between them.
decisions.revisit_if: Not applicable — this task's checklist is now fully satisfied by PR #107's final state.
